description: This file contains action creators related to user status management in a Mattermost web application, including functions to add users to status polling, load user statuses, and handle missing statuses.

methods.name: addVisibleUsersInCurrentChannelAndSelfToStatusPoll
methods.description: Adds users from current channel posts, DMs, and the current user to the status polling list.

methods.name: loadStatusesForProfilesList
methods.description: Loads statuses for a list of user profiles.

methods.name: loadStatusesByIds
methods.description: Loads statuses for specified user IDs if the feature is enabled.

methods.name: loadProfilesMissingStatus
methods.description: Loads statuses for user profiles missing status information.
